_doc: Declared race-furniture bands (ledger 0047). Index = vertex of data/centerline.local.json (engine frame x=E, y=up, z=N; same count as gate_centerline.json). centre_w_by_vertex: the centre chain's base width where it stands (0 elsewhere, incl. every island vertex except the shared nose). edge_strip_by_vertex: 1 where the kerb-line barrier runs on both curb faces (0 inside declared bridge spans). edge_inset_by_vertex: the LANE inset the strip takes from the lip (road mode) — 0 in walk mode. Band centres for the gates: centre = the centreline; edge = half_w + params.edge_centre_from_lip_m (signed outward). Written by tools/barrier_bands.py; consumed by tools/author_race_blend.py and scripts/geometry/median_zone.py.
